JORU — Free Desktop Trading Journal for Windows & macOS

JORU is an offline desktop trading journal and analytics workspace for systematic traders who want to understand the true drivers of their edge. Unlike cloud-based trade trackers like TradesViz or TraderSync, JORU keeps 100% of your trade logs, notes, and API keys strictly on your local machine.

Download Free for Windows & macOS

Key Features of JORU Trading Journal

Candlestick Chart Replay

Reopen any trade directly on its historical candlestick price chart. Inspect planned setups, entry executions, stop-loss, take-profit, actual exit points, and the exact strategy conditions on the candles that triggered them.

Karl-Nikolai I Habit Investigation

You remember catastrophic losses, but the costliest leaks are quiet: early entries before 10:00, revenge shorts after a red trade, or trading without confirmed setups. Karl-Nikolai I tests conditions across your trade history and ranks bad habits by dollar impact.

Genesis Matrix Strategy Builder

Map your trading strategy as an interconnected network of scenarios and execution rules. Every condition node displays its occurrence frequency and profit factor, making underperforming rules immediately evident.

Monte Carlo Risk Simulation

Stress-test your trading edge before market conditions change. The Monte Carlo engine runs 300 randomized shuffles of your historical trades, projecting drawdown ranges and the probability of adverse runs.

31 Deep Performance Metrics

Evaluate win rate, profit factor, Sharpe and Sortino ratios, average win/loss ratio, holding times, recovery factor, and strict strategy matrix adherence across all trade sessions.

100% Local Privacy Guarantee

Zero cloud surveillance. Your trade logs and notes are stored inside a local SQLite database on your device. Your trading edge, positions, and API keys never leave your computer.

Supported Broker & Exchange Imports

JORU provides native automated imports for active crypto, forex, futures, and stock traders:

  • MetaTrader 5 (MT5) — Comprehensive trade history report sync and automated logging.
  • Bybit — Perpetual futures and spot trade logs with fee and funding breakdown.
  • Binance — USD-M futures, Coin-M futures, and spot markets.
  • Kraken — Spot and margin cryptocurrency trade histories.
  • Interactive Brokers (IBKR) — Global equities, options, and futures execution records.

Frequently Asked Questions About JORU Trading Journal

What is JORU?
JORU is an offline desktop trading journal and analytics workspace for Windows and macOS. It helps traders systematically review trade executions, track risk metrics, test strategy conditions, and eliminate costly habits with the Karl-Nikolai I detection algorithm.
How does JORU compare to cloud journals like TradesViz, TraderSync or Edgewonk?
Unlike cloud SaaS platforms, JORU stores 100% of your trade records, screenshots, and exchange API keys locally on your computer in an embedded SQLite database. Your financial data is never tracked, leaked, or sold to third parties, and the application operates with zero latency and full offline capability.
Is JORU really free?
Yes. The Free plan is free forever with no trial period, time limits, or credit card required. It includes core journaling, trade tagging, screenshots, activity monitor, equity curves, and drawdown tracking. The Full plan ($9.99/mo) adds advanced Karl-Nikolai pattern detection, Genesis Matrix, and Monte Carlo risk simulations.
Which brokers and exchanges are supported for import?
JORU supports automated trade imports from MetaTrader 5 (MT5), Bybit, Binance, Kraken, and Interactive Brokers (IBKR), alongside manual trade logging with interactive candlestick chart replay.
Which operating systems are supported?
JORU runs natively on macOS 12 Monterey or newer (Universal binary supporting Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 and Intel) and 64-bit Windows 10/11.
How does Karl-Nikolai I detect costly habits?
Karl-Nikolai I tests individual conditions and combinations across your trading history (session time, trade direction, post-loss revenge trades) and ranks unprofitable patterns by statistical confidence and capital impact, helping you enforce discipline with objective rules.
